Rakoczy Gyorgy keleti osszekottetesei tortenetehez (1883, REAL-EOD 6176) no. 10, Rakoczi to Racz, Udvarhely 27 Apr 1642, pp. 665-668 (PDF pages 671-674), says 'Az czifrakkal valo irast magyarra megforditattuk ... megkuldtuk' and prints as its enclosure the Hungarian text of the cipher letter of Sebes, 19 Jan 1642, from Rakoczi's draft and a contemporary copy of the cipher ('A cursivval szedett egy egykoru masolat titkos irasabol van'). Racz (letters of 4 Mar and 15 May 1642, ibid. and Beke-Barabas 1888 pp. 583-585) could not read 'ket clavissal irt' letters (a reciprocal half-alphabet: 'az felso rend betuket az alsokon ... kell erteni') and sent them back, which is why a letter to Racz sits in the Rakoczi archive. Needs an image of no. 597 (MNL reading room or reproduction order) to compare with Szilagyi pp. 667-668 before any verdict; Lang 2015 p. 263 calls it 'nincs feltorve'.
